== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Too Cold For Speeders (Japanese)|Too Cold For Speeders]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/149261358/XgkveDPidEaGiui5XMiTgQ.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 149261358.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>2af50bff8c474af5bedcc7c37a272791fc8a3393022a2de314ffe6d5e4ee80dc</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
